principle: Consequences derive from real obligations plus confirmed evidence and context. Failure is not automatically misconduct; formal discipline requires due process and competent authority.
rules: An obligation must exist before a breach/consequence can exist.
Only confirmed evidence with provenance may resolve an obligation.
Academic failure/incompletion may require remediation without being misconduct.
Approved no-fault context may excuse fault while preserving make-up requirements.
Make-up and remediation are not punishment by themselves.
Wellbeing state alone neither excuses nor condemns an obligation outcome.
Repeated unexcused failures may trigger review only through authored recurrence thresholds.
Formal discipline requires a review basis and cannot be created directly from lateness/absence labels.
Intent, harm, orders, context and prior history are relevant to review severity.
There is no universal offense-to-sentence table.
Formal measure selection must be an explicitly represented decision, not resolver improvisation.
Competent authority and authority severity limits are mandatory.
The player is never assigned a confession, justification, appeal or acceptance automatically.
Final record write is deferred to Step 19.
Year advancement/repetition/leave/dismissal resolution is deferred to Step 18.
